correctness.rationale: For G=P4 Cartesian C4 (open four rows, periodic four columns), 16 vertices and 28 distinct edges, an independent Python reconstruction generated exactly 21,497 matchings including empty, with face counts 28,306,1672,4863,7416,5470,1620,121 by dimension 0..7. The first-available-edge greedy matching has 10,723 matched face pairs and exactly 1 critical vertex, 12 critical 4-cells and 37 critical 5-cells. Independently built the complete oriented nonempty Hasse incidence graph (107,288 incidences), and topological sorting visited all 21,496 vertices, establishing true acyclicity. Recalculated each signed gradient-path Morse boundary from the actual attached verify.py algorithm and boundary.json: 12x37 matrix, 108 nonzero entries, rank exactly ten, two explicit independent left annihilating rows and a determinant-minus-one 10x10 minor, Smith factors ten 1s. Because the 4-skeleton is a wedge of 4-spheres and pi4->H4 is an isomorphism there, these unit integral attaching columns cancel homotopy-theoretically, leaving 2 S4 and 27 S5. Mod-two homology alone would not exclude integral torsion. The full certificate for this one finite graph was independently replayed; no all-cylinders assertion is inferred.
